results.title: 当 `EnMasking=0` 时，`kmac_reduced` 仍无条件实例化 share1 消息 unpacker 并访问 `msg_i[1]` / `msg[1]`。
results.analysis_reason: This is a real RTL defect. `NumShares` is derived as `(EnMasking) ? 2 : 1`, so with `EnMasking=0` the module has only one valid share. However, `u_msg_unpacker_share1` is instantiated unconditionally and its ports still index `msg_i[1]`, `msg_ready_shares[1]`, `msg_valid_shares[1]`, and `msg[1]`. That creates an out-of-range share access in the unmasked configuration instead of guarding the second unpacker behind a generate conditioned on `NumShares > 1`.
results.trigger_condition: Instantiate `kmac_reduced` with `EnMasking=0`, which forces `NumShares=1` while the RTL still instantiates and connects the second message unpacker.
results.security_impact: The reduced KMAC core's unmasked configuration is structurally inconsistent and can fail elaboration or behave incorrectly under analysis/synthesis flows, undermining the intended reduced-core configuration used for evaluation and security analysis.
